Class Is Back In Session

Dear parents, guardians, students, & faculty who cannot keep their hands to themselves,

Welcome to another year at Friday Night Lights Pre-K, where the backpacks are packed, the rosters are fresh, and everyone arrived on the first day absolutely convinced they were the smartest kid in class. Some students followed directions. Some colored outside the lines. One left a player sitting alone on the nap mat. Another scored many points and still went home without a gold star.

It has been exactly one week, and we already have a blowout, two last-minute heartbreaks, one suspiciously lucky victory, and several children who need to work on sharing the football.

REMEMBER: one bad week does not define your season, but it will be displayed prominently on the classroom bulletin board (aka this newsletter).

With developmental concern,

Editor-in-Chief, Classroom Historian & Unlicensed Preschool Teacher

Playground Gossip

All gossip was overheard on the playground and should therefore be treated as fact.

"Meghana befriended Tyler Shough, watched him score 25.20 points from timeout, and still led the league."
"Abisshek left 29.80 points on the bench and is reportedly making his mom (AI) do his homework."
"Abhishek enrolled Waller, Jennings, Freiermuth, and Conner, then sent Jennings home early."
"The commissioners insist the classroom is under control. No independent sources have confirmed this."
"Shalaka won with zero TE points and has therefore learned nothing."
"Shree has already dropped enough players to qualify as a fully functioning lost-and-found."

WK1 LESSON:

Sharing is caring... UNLESS you are sharing wins with the rest of the league.
